name: Meat Puppets
label: SST
lede: Two brothers and a drummer from Phoenix who got bored of hardcore, turned it into desert country on acid, got a gold record thanks to Kurt Cobain, then lost a decade to heroin, a gunshot and a prison cell before coming back.

eras.title: Hardcore, briefly
eras.text: The Kirkwood brothers and Derrick Bostrom started out as a blur of Phoenix hardcore, loud and fast enough to catch SST's ear. Even then they were covering cowboy songs.

years.h: Curt and Cris Kirkwood start a band with Derrick Bostrom
years.p: Guitarist [[Curt Kirkwood|309c7dcf-6b22-43db-833e-121abfa9712f]], his bassist brother [[Cris Kirkwood|019cc4be-7da4-489b-9819-f3dd7dd5b234]] and drummer [[Derrick Bostrom|7a587694-6536-455d-87fc-93217d834e41]], who knew each other through Brophy Prep in Phoenix, form a trio. The brothers buy houses side by side in Tempe with a practice shed.

years.h: The band takes its name from a Curt Kirkwood song
years.p: The trio settles on Meat Puppets, the title of a Curt Kirkwood song that ends up on their first album.

years.h: In a Car EP, cut in Silver Lake for World Imitation
years.p: Five hardcore bursts on a 7-inch for the World Imitation label. The record catches the ear of SST's [[Joe Carducci|6f08ef70-2da6-4575-8ec2-22438145f5d2]].

years.h: Meat Puppets: a debut LP recorded in a single day
years.p: Engineered by [[Spot|d95a08a1-80f5-4232-bdb7-4777c369f0f9]] at Unicorn Studio and mixed the next May, the first album is released by SST in 1982. Between the hardcore sit covers of the cowboy standard Tumblin' Tumbleweeds and Doc Watson's Walking Boss.

eras.title: Cowpunk from the canal bed
eras.text: Bored of hardcore, the Meat Puppets slowed down and let country, psychedelia and the Grateful Dead in. Meat Puppets II and Up on the Sun didn't sell much, but they changed a lot of guitar players, from J Mascis to Kurt Cobain.

years.h: Meat Puppets II recorded, then shelved by SST for a year
years.p: The trio cuts Meat Puppets II with Spot at Total Access in Redondo Beach in April and May 1983. SST holds it back until April 1984.

q: so sick of the hardcore thing
years.h: Meat Puppets II trades hardcore for desert country
years.p: Plateau, Oh Me and Lake of Fire sit next to country shuffles and acid-rock jams. The cover art is by Curt Kirkwood and Neal Holliday.
years.xp:
Derrick Bostrom said the band was simply tired of hardcore. The record put the Meat Puppets alongside the Violent Femmes and the Gun Club at the front of what writers called cowpunk.

In November 1993 Kurt Cobain sang three of its songs, Plateau, Oh Me and Lake of Fire, on Nirvana's MTV Unplugged.

years.h: Up on the Sun, recorded and mixed in three days
years.p: Cut with Spot at Total Access from January 26 to 28, 1985. It's the first record where the Kirkwood brothers harmonize, and it gets played on mainstream rock radio in Phoenix.

years.h: Out My Way EP goes hard rock
years.p: Recorded at Chaton in Scottsdale. Right after, Curt Kirkwood breaks a finger when it's slammed in the tour van's door, pushing back the next album.

eras.title: Monsters and lawyers
eras.text: The Meat Puppets made three more SST albums in three years, swinging from synth-psych to ZZ Top boogie to metal. They wanted out, and the exit ended in lawsuits.

years.h: Mirage: synthesizers and electronic drums
years.p: Recorded in Scottsdale from November 1986 to January 1987. The songs prove so hard to play live that the tour lasts under six months.

years.h: Huevos, cut in five days in Phoenix
years.p: Recorded August 3 to 7, 1987 at Pantheon in Phoenix, mostly first takes. Curt Kirkwood said the Spanish title nodded to all those first takes.

years.h: Monsters: long jams and heavy metal
years.p: The last Meat Puppets album for SST, recorded in Orange, California. By now the band is openly chasing a major label.

years.h: SST puts out a best-of the band had no say in
years.p: No Strings Attached comes out on SST after the Meat Puppets leave, with no input from the band. The split turns into lawsuits that aren't settled until June 1993.

eras.title: Kurt Cobain's favorite band
eras.text: The Meat Puppets finally got a major label, then a far bigger gift: Kurt Cobain sang three of their songs on MTV. The gold record that followed was followed by the band coming apart.

years.h: Forbidden Places on London, ZZ Top's old label
years.p: The band's major-label debut, produced by Pete Anderson at Capitol in Hollywood. They picked London Records because it had been [[ZZ Top|a81259a0-a2f5-464b-866e-71220f2739f1]]'s first label.

years.h: John Frusciante auditions barefoot
years.p: Just out of the [[Red Hot Chili Peppers|8bfac288-ccc5-448d-9573-c33ea2aa5c30]], [[John Frusciante|f1571db1-c672-4a54-a2cf-aaa329f26f0b]] tries out as a second guitarist. Cris Kirkwood recalled him arriving barefoot with his guitar already out of its case. It didn't work out.

q: The mainstream veered off course and came over to my little puddle.
years.h: Kurt Cobain brings the Kirkwoods onto MTV Unplugged
years.p: Curt and Cris Kirkwood join [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]] in New York to play Plateau, Oh Me and Lake of Fire, all from Meat Puppets II. Kurt Cobain had been a fan since seeing them open for Black Flag.
years.xp: The Meat Puppets were already opening for Nirvana that year. MTV Unplugged in New York came out in November 1994, Nirvana's first release after Cobain's suicide that April, and Lake of Fire became a cult favorite for his vocal.

years.cap: Too High to Die, London Records, 1994
years.h: Too High to Die goes gold
years.p: Produced by [[Butthole Surfers|2339bc21-aa92-4850-86f0-4bb9433910c8]] guitarist [[Paul Leary|976549ea-72bb-45ea-9431-3f07b4ed7dc8]] in Memphis. Backwater reaches No. 47 on the Billboard Hot 100 and the album sells 500,000, more than all their earlier records combined.
years.xp: A new version of Lake of Fire sits at the end as a hidden track. On tour with Stone Temple Pilots, drugs were easy to get, and Cris Kirkwood's cocaine and heroin use got worse.

years.h: No Joke!: the label pulls out as Cris Kirkwood spirals
years.p: The last album by the original trio is heavier and darker, with Scum and Eyeball. When London learns of Cris Kirkwood's addiction it drops its support, and the record sells poorly.

eras.title: Tempe, heroin, a post office
eras.text: The trio broke up and Cris Kirkwood disappeared into heroin and crack in his Tempe house, where his wife and a close friend both died. Curt Kirkwood rebuilt the Meat Puppets name in Austin, while Cris ended up shot, convicted and in prison.

years.h: The original Meat Puppets break up
years.p: The band ends as Cris Kirkwood's heroin and crack use leaves him rarely leaving his Tempe house. Derrick Bostrom releases a solo EP as Today's Sounds.

years.h: Cris Kirkwood's wife Michelle Tardif dies
years.p: Michelle Tardif dies of an infection related to drug injection, according to Wikipedia. She is one of at least two people, with one of Cris Kirkwood's best friends, who died of drug use at his home in these years.

years.h: Curt Kirkwood revives the Meat Puppets name in Austin
years.p: Curt Kirkwood's Austin band Royal Neanderthal Orchestra becomes the Meat Puppets. Derrick Bostrom oversees Rykodisc reissues of the first seven records and the Live in Montana album.

years.h: Golden Lies with Doug Sahm's son on drums
years.p: Curt Kirkwood's new lineup: Kyle Ellison, Andrew Duplantis and drummer Shandon Sahm, son of [[Doug Sahm|b4745bd1-5db8-4523-8986-e09e3c1f3127]] of the Sir Douglas Quintet. It falls apart around 2002.

years.h: Cris Kirkwood shot by a guard at a Phoenix post office
years.p: An argument over a parking space at the main Phoenix post office ends with Cris Kirkwood hitting a security guard with the guard's own baton. The guard shoots him, and he needs major surgery.
years.xp:
Wikipedia's band article says he was shot in the stomach at least twice; his own article says in the back. He was denied bail because of earlier drug arrests and probation violations.

He pleaded guilty to assault with a deadly weapon in August 2004 and got 21 months.

years.h: Cris Kirkwood walks out of prison clean
years.p: Cris Kirkwood is released after kicking heroin inside. Curt Kirkwood, meanwhile, puts out his first solo album, Snow.

eras.title: The brothers, back
eras.text: A MySpace poll started the Meat Puppets back up, with the Kirkwoods together and a new drummer. They kept making records, played their classics in full for a new generation, and in 2018 got Derrick Bostrom back.

years.h: Curt Kirkwood polls MySpace about a reunion
years.p: Curt Kirkwood asks fans on MySpace whether the original lineup would interest anyone. The answer is yes within hours, but Derrick Bostrom shoots down the idea on the band's official site.

years.h: The Kirkwoods reunite, with Ted Marcus on drums
years.p: Billboard reports Curt and Cris Kirkwood are back together as the Meat Puppets. [[Primus|84dc4f23-c0b8-4fe1-bbca-a3993ddc8fc2]] drummer Tim Alexander is announced, then replaced by Ted Marcus.

years.h: Rise to Your Knees: the brothers' first record in 12 years
years.p: Released on Anodyne. The Meat Puppets tour with Cris Kirkwood for the first time in eleven years.

years.h: Meat Puppets II played in full at ATP New York
years.p: At All Tomorrow's Parties in New York the band plays its second album start to finish. In 2011 [[Animal Collective|0c751690-c784-4a4f-b1e4-c1de27d47581]] invite them to do the same with Up on the Sun at the ATP they curate.

years.h: Sewn Together on Megaforce
years.p: The band's first record for Megaforce. In November Shandon Sahm replaces Ted Marcus on drums.

years.h: Lollipop, and Curt's son Elmo joins
years.p: The 13th studio album. Elmo Kirkwood, Curt's son and Cris's nephew, starts touring as rhythm guitarist.

years.h: Rat Farm, and an opening slot for Dave Grohl
years.p: The 14th studio album follows a March set at SXSW opening for [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]]'s Sound City Players.

years.h: Derrick Bostrom rejoins the Meat Puppets
years.p: After a one-off with the band in August 2017, Derrick Bostrom replaces Shandon Sahm, and keyboardist Ron Stabinsky joins.

years.h: Dusty Notes: the original trio on record again
years.p: The 15th studio album, the first with Curt Kirkwood, Cris Kirkwood and Derrick Bostrom together since No Joke! in 1995.
